description.en: DeepSeek v4.1 flash 逆向工具（无限五代）     求 Star 收藏 ⭐欢迎大家提交项目的改进
Visual annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: select elements in local app previews and send structured UI feedback to your agent.
description.zh: 在本地应用预览里直接圈选界面元素，把结构化的 UI 反馈发给 AI 助手，改起来更准。

description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin that shows AnySearch references as cards, with the search query, source snippets and highlighted keywords in the right sidebar.一个 DSH 侧边栏插件，把 AnySearch 的搜索结果以卡片形式展示在右侧侧边栏中，包括搜索词、来源摘要和关键词高亮。
An automatically mounted, presentation-only progressive tool disclosure layer for every DeepSeek Harness Agent preset in Native, Code, and Both modes.
OpenViking memory integration for DeepSeek Harness with configurable automatic context injection; derived from the official OpenViking DSH plugin.
Windows computer-use capability for DSH: screenshot → vision model → simulated mouse/keyboard with self-evolving knowledge base. Dual-mode plugin tools + skill-only pwsh fallback.
description.zh: Windows 桌面识图+模拟操作能力：截图→vision模型→模拟鼠标键盘，内置自进化应用技巧库。支持插件工具模式和纯skill模式双形态。

description.en: Ocean-blue theme for the DSH web interface: swimming fish, rising bubbles, a daily-quote ticker above the input box, and a replacement brand area; Settings → Marine Theme exposes 7 groups and 32 options (brand text and size, badge, primary color, watermark, fish, quotes, overall scale) that apply instantly without a reload, plus a two-step reset to defaults.
description.zh: 海洋蓝主题：游动鱼群、上升气泡、输入框上方的「每日鱼语」，以及左上角品牌区替换；「设置 → 海洋主题」提供 7 组 32 项可调（品牌文字与字号、徽章、主色、水印、鱼群、语录、整体缩放），改动即时生效无需刷新，并带二次确认的一键恢复默认。

description.en: Imports a proxy subscription, supervises a local mihomo core (proxy-provider plus a url-test group), and fetches direct-first with automatic proxy fallback and per-host routing memory; exposes one proxy_router tool (status, start, stop, test, fetch, routes, forget).
description.zh: 导入代理订阅并监督本地 mihomo 内核（proxy-provider + url-test 组），取回时直连优先、失败自动切代理并按主机记忆路由；对外只有一个 proxy_router 工具（status/start/stop/test/fetch/routes/forget）。
